_note: FOLLOWUPS #23, Task E -- pre-registered signal-admission thresholds (decision J-2), committed BEFORE any candidate signal is scored against the harness. Rule (verbatim from #23): 'no new signal enters a composite unless it demonstrably reduces median point-in-time flip lag without materially increasing false flips.' 'Demonstrable' = at least `min_lag_reduction_days` of median confirmed-flip-lag reduction vs the baseline. 'Material' = a RELATIVE false-flip-rate increase exceeding `max_relative_false_flip_increase` (a baseline of zero false flips treats any new false flip as material, since a relative increase off zero is undefined/infinite). These starting values are round numbers chosen for economic sense (a signal shaving a fraction of a day off classification lag isn't worth added composite complexity; a modest false-flip tolerance accepts some noise in exchange for genuine lag reduction) -- they were NOT tuned against any candidate's results, since no candidate has been scored yet (this PR delivers baseline metrics only, per its own out-of-scope list). Revisit only with a stated reason recorded in this file.
